_doc: Audit test set. Each case is a claim made by the Matching agent (requirement, status, quotes). 'expected' is the verdict a careful recruiter would give: supported (the quote proves the status), overstated (related but weaker: the status should be lowered), unsupported (the quote does not concern the requirement). Quotes marked source=run come from the real run 20261028-160545-a88e88 (Kaggle CVs); source=written are written by us to cover the categories. Labels written by Claude: to be confirmed by two team members (column 'reviewed_by').
